articles.title: OpenAI Releases GPT-5 Turbo with Native Multimodal Reasoning Across Code, Vision, and Audio
articles.summary: OpenAI launched GPT-5 Turbo, featuring deeply integrated multimodal reasoning that can jointly process code repositories, visual diagrams, and spoken instructions in a single inference pass. Benchmarks show a 38% improvement on SWE-Bench over GPT-4.5 and significantly reduced hallucination rates on factual retrieval tasks. The model is available through the API with a new streaming architecture that reduces time-to-first-token by over 50%.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Ultra 2 Achieves Silver Medal Performance on International Math Olympiad Problems
articles.summary: DeepMind announced that Gemini Ultra 2 solved 4 out of 6 problems on a held-out set of recent IMO-level competition problems, achieving an effective silver medal. The system leverages a novel chain-of-thought search process combined with formal verification using Lean 4, representing a major step toward AI systems that can perform rigorous mathematical reasoning with provable correctness.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 Begins Pilot Deployment in Amazon Fulfillment Centers
articles.summary: Amazon confirmed a pilot program deploying 1,000 Tesla Optimus Gen 3 humanoid robots across three fulfillment centers in Texas and Ohio for pick-and-pack operations. The robots use on-device vision-language models for zero-shot object manipulation and reportedly achieve 85% of human pick rates. The partnership signals accelerating commercialization of general-purpose humanoid robotics in logistics.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics Atlas Now Performs Autonomous Multi-Floor Building Inspections
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics demonstrated its electric Atlas robot autonomously navigating multi-story commercial buildings, climbing stairs, opening doors, and conducting visual and thermal inspections without human teleoperation. The system uses a combination of LiDAR SLAM and foundation-model-based scene understanding to build real-time 3D maps and flag structural or mechanical anomalies. Several commercial real estate firms have signed contracts for 2027 deployments.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces 'Constitutional Classifiers' to Defend Against Jailbreak Attacks on Enterprise AI
articles.summary: Anthropic published research on Constitutional Classifiers, a layered defense system that reduces successful jailbreak rates on Claude deployments to under 1% across red-team evaluations. The technique trains lightweight classifier models on synthetically generated adversarial prompts guided by constitutional principles, adding minimal latency. Enterprise customers in healthcare and finance are already integrating the system for compliance-critical deployments.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Risk Production of 1.4nm A14 Process Node Ahead of Schedule
articles.summary: TSMC announced that risk production on its A14 (1.4nm-class) process node has commenced at Fab 20 in Hsinchu, several months ahead of the original timeline. The node utilizes gate-all-around nanosheet transistors with backside power delivery, promising 25% performance gains or 35% power reduction versus the N2 node. Apple and Nvidia are expected to be lead customers with chips taping out in early 2027.

articles.title: Waymo Surpasses 10 Million Fully Autonomous Rides as Expansion Hits Tokyo
articles.summary: Waymo announced it has completed over 10 million fully driverless rides globally and is launching its first non-US commercial service in Tokyo in partnership with Nihon Kotsu. The Tokyo deployment uses a new sensor suite optimized for dense urban environments with high pedestrian and cyclist traffic. Waymo's cumulative autonomous miles now exceed 100 million across San Francisco, Phoenix, Los Angeles, Austin, and Tokyo.

articles.title: Figure AI Raises $1.5B Series C to Scale Humanoid Robot Manufacturing
articles.summary: Figure AI closed a $1.5 billion Series C at a $15 billion valuation led by Microsoft and Bezos Expeditions, earmarked for building a dedicated humanoid robot manufacturing facility in South Carolina. The company's Figure 03 robot integrates an on-device multimodal model co-developed with OpenAI for natural language task instruction and adaptive manipulation. Figure plans to produce 10,000 units annually by late 2027 for automotive and logistics customers.
